name: mirage
text: Version 1.0.72 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.72 . It includes three things. (1) The logger: every time a bet leaves the +EV list, the app records which check hid it, how old its odds were, and when most of the list drops at once. That tells us why your bets vanish and return. (2) The CNO fix, so a price nobody sold at stays off the list. (3) Kalshi bets now show in the +EV list even with the Kalshi switch OFF. Install it, use the +EV tab for a few minutes while the vanishing happens, then send me the diagnostics file and I'll read the cause. If the bets turn out to rest on stale odds, they will stop showing at all.
